budget_method: Each final boundary has N success, N-1 ResourceLimit, and fresh N success with the same produced result. Default budgets were not raised. These exact new-path figures do not claim every legacy profile has been independently remeasured.
review_findings: The public State binding table contains two separately validated declaration slots and real source field selectors. Same concrete ClosureId does not merge weak F/G modes or per-value resource responsibilities. Reversed source field order and repeated actual C remain covered.

Current-function origins survive full T calls, explicit TypeApply, bare value inference, Name, annotations, field take to local/helper, Store borrowing/pop, and both error-union sides. Source, nominal/phantom identities and four-module equal short names were exercised. Raw Record preparation/value and TypeApply slot swaps cannot strengthen G when actual types coincide.

Definition-time checks run for unused declarations. Fn/FnMut/FnOnce bounds supply no Copy promise: duplicate field takes and reuse after owned-helper transfer reject even when the actual closure happens to be Copy. Fresh local owners and legitimate disjoint fields remain usable.

The final alias ledger keys actual parents and distinct borrow generations, remembers shared/exclusive kind, preserves parent chains, and never clears old invalidation after take/refill. Preparing the callee before arguments stores a distinct prepared loan; arguments are prepared once and that saved callee is checked again. Repeated use through the same live view remains allowed.

The repeated-loop condition use set is collected before the body for While and WhileLet. It participates in the same back-edge check as body uses. ForRange boundaries remain once-evaluated. The original missed-condition Core counterexample rejects after the narrow fix.

Both concrete callback roots are checked independently for finite capture graphs, actual Copy results in the new distinct-root profile, real layout, live flags and nonzero full element stride. Empty-closure-only source fails the actual canonical qualification; its captured-value neighbor succeeds. No-Store identity still carries its actual complete canonical Store type.

Analyze/raw Verify/encoded Wire do not accept malformed actual second capture graphs, extra callback fields, non-Copy results or stale schema versions merely because a first root passed. A raw program with erased source declarations is not claimed to prove source-equivalent mode semantics; that contract is checked in Core/Types before erasure.

CT normalization preserves both State bindings and static type/value call identity, supplies the genuine i64 runtime scalar context across modules, and refuses to execute the templates or wrappers during CT. Shadowing and early oversized metadata remain checked with actual queries and recorded phases.

The final Linux oracle is independent of observed outcomes: declared source layouts predict the 72-byte State stride, allocator sequence and complete drop markers. O0/O2 actual executions match that oracle, including immediate Fn-to-FnOnce cleanup, partial push failure, preserved live Store on failed growth, and every real allocation-failure prefix.
